## The claim

P4-14: Evo 2 1B ranks the confirmed pair in the top decile of its own pair ranking

**Prediction if true.** the evo2 lane scores both confirmed alleles and the confirmed pair's percentile is at or under 10

**What would refute it.** the lane abstains on either confirmed allele, or the pair sits above the median of the lane's ranking
